_comment: Negative twin of aa_stroke_decks_opponent.json: ONE mana short (4 Forest + the drawn-and-played Forest + Alchemist = 6, so X <= 3
against a 4-card library). The opponent variant is not lethal, the provider does not offer it, and
no damage clock exists -- so the engine must NOT win on turn 4. Guards against a spurious deck-out
(e.g. a ForcedDraw that flagged a partial draw, or an empty-is-not-absent regression).
